summary: Diff updates shared quiz layout components (QuizPage, QuizResultSection) to use a white page background and to render result sections as centered, rounded, bordered cards with optional "brand" background (bg-neutral-light). However, the diff summary is truncated for TravelStyleQuiz.tsx, so it’s not verifiable from the provided evidence that all three specific result sections on the finishing/results screen are using the same tile background color and border treatment, nor that any prior full-width colored stripe on that specific screen was removed via the page implementation. Also includes changes to project_state.json and frontend-file-summaries.txt that were not requested by the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: On the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results page, make all three result sections (“Your Travel Style”, “Your Ideal Destinations”, “Your Personal Packing List”) render as distinct tiles/cards with a filled background matching the current “Your Ideal Destinations” background, and ensure there is no full-width colored stripe behind them.
missing_requirements.reason: While QuizResultSection supports a 'brand' background (bg-neutral-light) and now renders content inside a card, the diff does not show (due to truncation) that TravelStyleQuiz finishing/results actually renders all three sections as tiles using that same background, or that any existing full-width stripe on that page was removed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Make the borders for the three finishing/results tiles match the site’s existing tile border styling (consistent border color, thickness, radius, overall look).
missing_requirements.reason: QuizResultSection hardcodes `border border-neutral-light rounded-xl shadow-lg`, but the diff provides no evidence this matches the border color/treatment used by other tiles elsewhere on the site, and no evidence that all three finishing/results tiles use it (TravelStyleQuiz usage is truncated).

hallucinated_features.description: Updated/added broad project tracking metadata in project_state.json unrelated to the UI tile-only background change request.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request changes to project_state.json or any project tracking artifacts.
BuildRequest focuses on Travel Style Quiz results styling; it does not request updates to repository summary/documentation artifacts.
